description: Land Acquisition - Gongithota, Mahara D/S Division, Gampaha District  and an amendment to the Gaz. Ex. No. 2008/11 of 28.02.2017, Ududumbara D/S Division
categorisation: This gazette content is exclusively about land acquisition matters. It contains two separate notices under Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, both detailing specific land parcels to be acquired by the government for public purposes. The content includes descriptions of land locations, extents, lot numbers, and procedures for compensation claims. The document is explicitly labeled "PART III - LANDS" and "Land Acquisition Notices," confirming its focus on land-related administrative matters rather than government personnel, organizational changes, or other specialized categories.
